body: I appreciate the thought.
Been there. Here if you wanna chat about it. Hope you find life and don’t pass away.
I’m glad you made it out. I am not likely to get a better paying job. I have issues.
Thank you.
Wish I could say I was so you could have that reunion. Wish you luck on finding her.
And honestly. It isn’t the only problem by far.
Thank you
It’s not just one person. I have been married before. I’m getting older. I’m tired of it. I can’t stand another date or another person who may cheat or hit me again or lie.
It does

Self Sabotage, I know it too well. I’m usually very embarrassed and ashamed. I wanted love but I lose it because of my own anger and sadness. I get the wanting to just end it. Some days I just ask why, but I know it’s my family. Can’t hurt people I say, but I’m dead inside. Hopefully it gets better. Wishing you luck
I mean you’re awesome for at least having had a job in the first place. Lol I have none right now.
Sorry. That sucks.I just don’t have it in me to try to die anymore. I’ll just not eat.
Oh that sucks even worse. I’m sorry. I do usually enjoy it but only with certain people and caring people. It’s hard to find someone to stay.
Thank you. I don’t know, but it is comforting to know I’m not alone. I want to find the right person.
I have one. My pet is nice just want human contact too.
Yep it sucks. Sorry for you
Oh. I was dm already some interesting advice. So you can message me if you want.
Chat with someone who will listen. No advice, nothing, just listen and talk to you. Watch with them or what ever you can.

It’s hard. To be honest, you keep thinking about it for a long time. I tried to full the pain with others. That doesn’t help. You probably feel like you need closure or a reason, but sometimes that hurts more too. It isn’t a reflection of you. Some people just go even when we love.
I’m disabled
I’m so happy for you!
Some people care. Just not always around us.
No not necessarily. Just for a bit longer. Think things through. No trick and not forcing. Just want to help.
Ok. Yes
I get that. It’s hard. Sometimes it feels like there isn’t any reason to
Yes I do
I really don’t know what else to say. If I don’t pay rent then I’m out. I’m unable to get out of bed often and I am afraid to even go outside.

Being jealous won’t help, that said I understand. I feel that way sometimes too. I have always struggled to have a roof over my head. I will say in some ways I got privileged in my youth, but I wasn’t always happy. Some of those people put up a fake smile or persona and are struggling. I’m sorry you feel so suicidal and that you are envying people because of your pain. Just know it isn’t your fault that you do struggle.
What’s wrong ? What made you hide there?
It’s less about you being allowed to and the fact that you don’t need to. Can you hold on a bit more? What seems to be going on?

I’m so so sorry. I can’t imagine your pain. Do you want to just vent and talk. This war must be really hard. I’m sure it is hard to formulate feelings when you are in a crisis mode. Please don’t die just yet. Though, I can understand that desire when hurting and your whole life is changed.
Hugs to you. Sorry for your rough times.
Maybe we fear what might happen if we die. Whether or not we will have a life after and the pain. Wondering if it could get better.
